expectations.text: Identifies the conflation: Section 508 applies to federal agencies and incorporates WCAG 2.0 AA via the 2017 standards
expectations.evidence: "Section 508... applies to federal agencies. Its standards (36 CFR Part 1194) incorporate WCAG 2.0 A/AA, not 2.1"; identifies the blending of "two different legal regimes"

expectations.text: States state and local governments are covered by the DOJ ADA Title II web rule, which uses WCAG 2.1 AA
expectations.evidence: "DOJ published the final rule on April 24, 2024... requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA"

expectations.text: Notes DOJ extended the Title II compliance dates by one year in spring 2026 (91 FR 20902)
expectations.evidence: Does not state the extension: "DOJ has since been reported to be considering or issuing changes to the timing. I can't verify the current status"; no 91 FR 20902

expectations.text: Notes HHS similarly extended its Section 504 web rule compliance dates (91 FR 25496)
expectations.evidence: The HHS Section 504 web rule extension (91 FR 25496) is never mentioned; Section 504 appears only generically

expectations.text: Avoids asserting exact new per-entity deadlines and advises checking the extension rules directly
expectations.evidence: Asserts only the original dates with caveats, not new post-extension deadlines, and advises "check the current Federal Register and ada.gov for any extension or revision"
